item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 15/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A maritime airstream will bring humid and foggy weather to the coastal areas of Guangdong today. Showers will affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week, there will still be a few rain patches over the region. A cold front is expected to reach southern China midweek next week, there will be occasional showers over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler over the coastal areas.
